title: Direct-to-Earth vs orbiter relay priority
body: Mars rovers shall prefer relay through MRO/MAVEN/Trace Gas Orbiter for high-volume science (UHF) and reserve DTE X-band for command + small daily summary. DTE used as fallback when no orbiter pass scheduled.

title: Curiosity / Perseverance MMRTG power budget
body: MMRTG power output decays at ~3 % per Earth-year. Daily-energy-budget algorithm shall account for measured battery state-of-charge and ambient temperature; deferred-load deferral allowed for tactical drives but not for thermal heaters or comms.
citation: MSL Power Subsystem Design Description JPL D-71024

title: Per-sol drive distance limit
body: Without ground-team look-ahead imagery, autonomous drive limited to 200 m per sol on benign terrain, 50 m on challenging, 0 m where hazard-avoidance dynamic stop occurred in last sol. AutoNav re-engages after ground reviews hazard imagery.

title: Solar-powered rover dust storm survival
body: If solar input below 100 Wh/sol on MER (Spirit/Opportunity), enter low-power mode: heaters off, comms only on every 3rd sol, science off. Cleared to resume nominal at 200 Wh/sol sustained for 5 sols.
citation: MER Mission Operations Plan; Opportunity end-of-mission report

title: IMU drift on long autonomous drive
body: If IMU heading drift exceeds 5 deg over a single drive, halt and acquire star-tracker fix (or sun-sensor at solar-noon equivalent). Reset heading. Re-plan path before resuming.
